verdict.rationale: Mixpanel does support account/company-level (group) analytics for B2B use cases, but the evidence pack lacks first-party docs describing this feature directly — the only confirmation comes from a community report noting that group-level/account-level analytics 'useful for B2B SaaS' exists but is 'tucked away on one of Mixpanel's higher price plans,' limiting access for many customers. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Group Analytics feature, details on setup/limits, and independent hands-on validation beyond the pricing-gate complaint.
